signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION ZLA_SYRPVGRW( UPLO, N, INFO, A, LDA, AF,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: info
params.reference: The value of `INFO` returned from ZSYTRF, .i.e., the pivot in column `INFO` is exactly 0.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-N matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: AF
params.reference: The block diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L as computed by ZSYTRF.

params.name: ldaf
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AF`. $\mathrm{LDAF} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZSYTRF.
